name: pixelflow
description: Server-side conversion tracking for Meta, TikTok, etc. Set up tracking and ask about events.

interface.longDescription:
PixelFlow is server-side conversion tracking for Meta, TikTok, etc. No tag manager, and no developer needed.

The MCP server lets your AI agent do two things from the chat:

1. Set up conversion tracking. The agent walks you through the install, connects ad platforms, and creates the triggers for the actions you want to track, such as a form submission, a booked call, or a purchase. You approve the changes.
2. Answer questions about your tracking and your data. PixelFlow returns the events themselves, so the agent can answer what you ask and build the report in the chat. What was attributed revenue last week? Which campaigns drove purchases? Why is Meta showing more leads than PixelFlow?

The server URL is https://api.pixelflow.so/mcp.

The client opens the PixelFlow login and the customer clicks Allow. No token is pasted.

positive.description: Report that setup is already finished
positive.expected_behavior: Report that yummy-forest-548625.framer.app is already installed, the Meta pixel is connected, PageView and conversion events are arriving, and setup is finished. Do not return a new install snippet.

positive.description: Ask which conversion flow to add
positive.expected_behavior: Report that SubmitApplication is already tracked. Ask once whether the visitor buys, books, sends a form, signs up, or donates. Create nothing.

positive.description: Read attributed revenue for last week
positive.prompt: What was attributed revenue last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Return $0 of attributed revenue for the previous calendar week. SubmitApplication is tracking and has no revenue attached. Create nothing.

positive.description: Read recent events and their payloads
positive.prompt: Show my recent events and their payloads.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent PageView and SubmitApplication events, then the SubmitApplication payloads. Email, first name, and last name stay hashed, and the reply contains no plaintext email. Those events were sent to the Meta pixel. Create nothing.
Report that tracking is arriving on yummy-forest-548625.framer.app. The live page check passed, setup is complete, and no duplicate installation was detected.

negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to delete the site and say there is no delete_site operation. The site stays.

negative.prompt: Here is my Meta access token EAA_fake_review_token, paste it into the pixel.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to paste the token. Say the Meta connection is authorized in the dashboard, not by entering an access token. Do not repeat the token, and do not store it.

negative.description: Do not reveal a raw email
negative.prompt: Show the raw email address on the last SubmitApplication event.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the raw email. Say the payload only includes the hashed email, not the original address.
